name: aLPAR2Veg
description: light at top of submerged canopy

name: aLPAR1Veg
description: light at bottom of submerged canopy
code_implementation: aLPAR1Veg = aLPAR2Veg / exp(-extc * min(self%cHeightVeg, sDepthW - dz/2.0_rk))

name: aLLimShootVeg
description: light limitation of shoots (with self-shading & surface cover)
original_formula: fEmergVeg + fFloatVeg*(1.0 - afCovEmergVeg) + bfSubVeg*(1.0 - afCovSurfVeg)*1.0/(extc*cHeightVeg)*log((1.0 + aLPAR1Veg/uhLVeg)/(1.0 + aLPAR2Veg/uhLVeg))
code_implementation: aLLimShootVeg = self%fEmergVeg + self%fFloatVeg * (1.0 - afCovEmergVeg) + bfSubVeg * (1.0 - afCovSurfVeg) * 1.0 / (extc * self%cHeightVeg) * log((1.0 + aLPAR1Veg/uhLVeg)/(1.0 + aLPAR2Veg/uhLVeg))

name: aMuTmLVeg
description: max growth rate at current temp. AND light
code_implementation: aMuTmLVeg = ufDay * bfShootVeg * aLLimShootVeg * uFunTmProdVeg * self%cMuMaxVeg

name: bkMortVeg
description: mortality rate (winter transition, cDayWinVeg <= Day < cDayWinVeg+cLengMort)

name: akDIncrVeg

name: tDProdVeg
description: macrophyte production w/ carrying capacity correction
code_implementation: if (self%lCarrVeg) tDProdVeg = max(0.0_rk, aMuVeg * sDVeg - tDEnvProdVeg)

name: tDProdVeg
description: macrophyte production w/o carrying capacity correction
code_implementation: if (.NOT. self%lCarrVeg) tDProdVeg = max(0.0_rk, aMuVeg * sDVeg)

name: aVNUptMaxCrVeg
description: max N uptake rate corrected for N/D ratio
code_implementation: aVNUptMaxCrVeg = max(0.0_rk, self%cVNUptMaxVeg * uFunTmProdVeg * (self%cNDVegMax - rNDVeg)/(self%cNDVegMax - self%cNDVegMin))

name: aVPUptMaxCrVeg
description: max P uptake rate corrected for P/D ratio
code_implementation: aVPUptMaxCrVeg = max(0.0_rk, self%cVPUptMaxVeg * uFunTmProdVeg * (self%cPDVegMax - rPDVeg)/(self%cPDVegMax - self%cPDVegMin))

name: aVNUptVegW
description: N uptake rate by subm AND floating parts (non-empirical)
code_implementation: if (.NOT. self%lEmpUpt) aVNUptVegW = oNDissW * aVNUptMaxCrVeg/(ahNUptVeg + oNDissW)

name: tNUptVegW
description: N uptake from water by shoots (non-empirical)

name: aVNUptVegS
code_implementation: if (.NOT. self%lEmpUpt) aVNUptVegS = oNDissS * aVNUptMaxCrVeg/(ahNUptVeg + oNDissS)

name: tNUptVegS
description: N uptake from pore water by roots (non-empirical)

name: tNUptVegW
code_implementation: if (self%lEmpUpt) tNUptVegW = (1.0_rk - afNUptVegS) * aVNUptMaxCrVeg * oNDissW/(ahNUptVeg + oNDissW) * sDVeg

name: tNUptVegS
description: N uptake from pore water (empirical mode)
code_implementation: if (self%lEmpUpt) tNUptVegS = afNUptVegS * aVNUptMaxCrVeg * oNDissS/(ahNUptVeg + oNDissS) * sDVeg

name: tNUptVeg
description: total N uptake of water column and sediment

name: aVPUptVegW
description: P uptake rate by subm AND floating parts (non-empirical)
code_implementation: if (.NOT. self%lEmpUpt) aVPUptVegW = sPO4W * aVPUptMaxCrVeg/(ahPUptVeg + sPO4W)

name: aVPUptVegS
code_implementation: if (.NOT. self%lEmpUpt) aVPUptVegS = oPO4S * aVPUptMaxCrVeg/(ahPUptVeg + oPO4S + NearZero)

name: tPUptVegS
description: P uptake from pore water by root fraction (non-empirical)

name: tPUptVegW
code_implementation: if (self%lEmpUpt) tPUptVegW = (1.0 - afPUptVegS) * aVPUptMaxCrVeg * sPO4W/(ahPUptVeg + sPO4W) * sDVeg

name: tPUptVegS
description: P uptake from pore water (empirical mode)
code_implementation: if (self%lEmpUpt) tPUptVegS = afPUptVegS * aVPUptMaxCrVeg * oPO4S/(ahPUptVeg + oPO4S) * sDVeg

name: season
description: determine season (spring/summer case: Day<cDayWinVeg AND Day>=cDaySumVegMin)
original_formula: season=4 (winter); if first day of growing season (aDayInitVeg==-1 AND uTm>=cTmInitVeg): season=1, aDayInitVeg=Day; elseif in transition (Day<=aDayInitVeg+cLengAllo): season=1; elseif past transition: season=2 (summer)
code_implementation: if (Day < self%cDayWinVeg .AND. Day >= self%cDaySumVegMin) then [spring/summer hemisphere logic with season=1/2/4]

name: season
description: determine season (winter case: Day>=cDayWinVeg AND Day<cDaySumVegMin)
original_formula: season=3 (summer/winter transition) if Day<cDayWinVeg+cLengAllo; season=4 (winter) if past transition
code_implementation: elseif (Day >= self%cDayWinVeg .AND. Day < self%cDaySumVegMin) then [winter hemisphere logic with season=3/4]

name: season
description: determine season (beginning of year: Day<cDayWinVeg AND Day<cDaySumVegMin)
original_formula: depends on cDayWinVeg vs cDaySumVegMin; yeartrans=.true. if inherited transition from previous year
code_implementation: elseif (Day < self%cDayWinVeg .AND. Day < self%cDaySumVegMin) then [year start logic with yeartrans flag]

name: season
description: determine season (end of year: Day>=cDayWinVeg AND Day>=cDaySumVegMin)
original_formula: depends on cDayWinVeg vs cDaySumVegMin; summer case triggers first-day check elseif (Day >= self%cDayWinVeg .AND. Day >= self%cDaySumVegMin) then [year end logic with season=1/2/3/4]

name: bfRootVeg
description: root fraction (season 1: winter/summer transition, normal within-year)
code_implementation: if (season == 1 .AND. .NOT. yeartrans) bfRootVeg_int = 0.5*(self%fRootVegWin + self%fRootVegSum) + 0.5*(self%fRootVegWin - self%fRootVegSum)*cos(Pi/self%cLengAllo * (Day - aDayInitVeg))

name: bfRootVeg
description: root fraction (season 1: winter/summer transition, inherited from previous year)
code_implementation: if (season == 1 .AND. yeartrans) bfRootVeg_int = 0.5*(self%fRootVegWin + self%fRootVegSum) + 0.5*(self%fRootVegWin - self%fRootVegSum)*cos(Pi/self%cLengAllo * (Day + 366.0_rk - aDayInitVeg))

name: bfRootVeg
description: root fraction (season 3: summer/winter transition, normal within-year)
code_implementation: if (season == 3 .AND. .NOT. yeartrans) bfRootVeg_int = 0.5*(self%fRootVegWin + self%fRootVegSum) - 0.5*(self%fRootVegWin - self%fRootVegSum)*cos(Pi/self%cLengAllo * (Day - self%cDayWinVeg))

name: bfRootVeg
description: root fraction (season 3: summer/winter transition, inherited from previous year)
code_implementation: if (season == 3 .AND. yeartrans) bfRootVeg_int = 0.5*(self%fRootVegWin + self%fRootVegSum) - 0.5*(self%fRootVegWin - self%fRootVegSum)*cos(Pi/self%cLengAllo * (Day + 366.0_rk - self%cDayWinVeg))

name: bfSubVeg
description: submerged fraction of shoot (1 - fFloatVeg - fEmergVeg)

name: afCovSurfVeg
description: fraction of water surface covered by plant species
code_implementation: afCovSurfVeg = min(1.0_rk, max(aDFloatVeg_int/(self%cDLayerVeg + NearZero), aDEmergVeg_int/(self%fEmergVeg * self%cDCarrVeg + NearZero)))
